title: A Treatise on the Narrow Gale
summary: A treatise on squeezing wind into thin needles and fine blades that pierce guards where a broad gust would only push.

title: Canon of the Whirlwind Guard
summary: A canon of defence by whirling air that wraps the student in a turning mantle and returns heavy blows to their senders.

title: The Open Sky Breath Canon
summary: A canon on spreading the qi field wide and letting it move as wind so that the student strikes and senses past arm's reach.

title: Manual of the Returned Breath
summary: A manual of the breath arts that clear foul air from the lungs and call back a stopped breath within a short window.

title: The Treatise of Paired Gusts
summary: A treatise on throwing gusts in pairs so that the first draws a guard open and the second lands on the gap.

title: The Azure Court Wind Manual
summary: A court manual of stern and measured wind arts that rebuke an opponent with exact strokes and close with a judging gale.

title: A Dual-Track Compendium of Air
summary: A compendium on running guard and attack on two tracks of wind at once with the qi field spread round the body.

title: Manual of the Sworn Bearing
summary: A manual of the wind-sworn who take a bearing and hold it so that every step and strike keeps true to the course.

title: The Oath of the Open Air
summary: A manual of the sworn open hand that fights in the open field of qi and answers every cover with a clearing gale.

title: Treatise on the Unwalled Gale
summary: A treatise on the gale that has no walls and no end and that scours an open field of foes and foul air alike.
